text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $78.5K while Ethereum outpaced it with a 2.2% gain, suggesting selective strength in altcoins despite Bitcoin's larger dominance share of 59.2%. The Fear & Greed index at 65 and rising sharply over the past week reflects growing confidence, though $77B in daily volume remains moderate relative to recent peaks, indicating cautious optimism rather than euphoria-driven accumulation.
